# The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
# flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and builds them with the game waiting: those
# above the first "section" line before the game starts, and a level's section when the level first draws with its
# shaders, so that nothing draws with the ubershader, which integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's
# docs/porting.md, Prebuilt shader lists).
#
# Recorded by code, not by playing: bash tools/record_shaders.sh (its header says how) runs N64Recomp-browser's
# tools/record_shaders.mjs with tools/shader_plan.json, which loads the page fresh for each section. Section 0 is the
# launcher, the boot as it plays by itself (the logos, the intro in dataDyne Central, the title) and the file menu,
# reached with Start as a player does. Then a section a solo mission, the 17 of the story and the 4 special ones,
# each started from the file menu by patches/shader_survey.c as mission select's Accept does, on Agent: 8 s of its
# opening cutscene, the rest skipped with A, then about 30 s of the game's time from where it starts Joanna, who is
# invincible (tools/shader_survey.js): walking out and back by as much, strafing, turning, firing, aiming and
# reloading. Not recorded: the menus behind an agent file (the Perfect Menu, mission select, the briefing, the
# end screen), Combat Simulator, the Carrington Institute, and what a mission draws further in than its start (RT64
# builds those when the game first asks for them). Flags follow settings (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so a
# change to one of those defaults means recording again.
# Added by hand at the end of their section: the shaders the page's play plans then missed (the boot 1,
# Defection 15, 9 of them as it starts in Firefox alone; Villa 3), and those plays of a minute in each solo mission
# then missed (20 in seven: Villa 2, G5 Building 5, Crash Site 3, Rescue 3, Defense 5, Skedar Ruins 1, Maian SOS 1),
# and plays of a route through 12 of them that turns, strafes, fires and aims then missed (28 in five: G5 Building 13,
# 5 of them Firefox's alone and 8 Chrome's; Air Base 5, 4 of them Firefox's alone; Crash Site 4, Defense 5, Skedar
# Ruins 1), and the same route then missed 2 more in Air Base from Pages, and the boot as it plays by itself
# for 45 s (publish_pages.sh's boot check) 3, and Firefox as the intro's Defection loads 1.
# A new recording drops them unless they are added again.
